macros.name: px
macros.doc: You can output a pixel using \px, and skip a pixel using \pxskip.

macros.name: pxpic
macros.doc: \pxpic parses the ⟨pixel list⟩ and draws the corresponding picture.

macros.name: pxpicforget
macros.doc: Undefines the ⟨px⟩ definition for use in mode=px (or skip symbol) added with the colours (or skip) option.

macros.name: pxpiclogo
macros.doc: The logo is just a biggish pixel picture.

macros.name: pxpicnewmode
macros.doc: You can define your own modes with \pxpicnewmode.

macros.name: pxpicsetup
macros.doc: Sets the ⟨options⟩ locally to the current TeX group.
